reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Kattankudy Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local authority position, including the nomination and declaration of a new member to fill a seat vacated by resignation. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities.
